routines.title: HIIT Power

routines.title: Pilates Core Flow
routines.summary: Controlled core work on the floor — deep strength without the strain.

steps.name: Breathing warm-up
steps.cue: On your back, knees bent. Breathe wide into your ribs.

steps.name: Modified hundred
steps.cue: Head down or lifted. Pump your arms gently, five counts in, five out.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe. Shake it out. Next one's coming.

steps.name: Dead bug
steps.cue: Low back stays down. Slow and controlled.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe. Shake it out. Next one's coming.

steps.name: Single-leg stretch
steps.cue: Hug one knee in, extend the other leg long. Switch smoothly.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe. Shake it out. Next one's coming.

steps.name: Bridge with march
steps.cue: Lift your hips, then lift one foot at a time without dropping.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe. Shake it out. Next one's coming.

steps.name: Side-lying leg lifts — left
steps.cue: Lie on your side, lift the top leg slowly.

steps.name: Side-lying leg lifts — right
steps.cue: Switch sides.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe. Shake it out. Next one's coming.

steps.name: Swimming
steps.cue: On your belly, lift opposite arm and leg in small, steady flutters.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe. Shake it out. Next one's coming.

steps.name: Plank shoulder taps
steps.cue: Knees down if needed. Keep your hips still.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Sink back and breathe into your back.

routines.title: Brisk Prayer Walk
routines.summary: A brisk walk with guided prayer prompts. Steps count toward your goal.

routines.title: Gentle Yoga Flow
routines.summary: Slow, restorative poses to release tension and settle your mind.

steps.name: Bird dog
steps.cue: From hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg long. Alternate slowly, breathing with each reach.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Knees wide, arms long, forehead down. Breathe into your back.

steps.name: Low lunge — left
steps.cue: Left foot forward, back knee down. Sink your hips gently.

steps.name: Low lunge — right
steps.cue: Switch sides.

steps.name: World's greatest stretch
steps.cue: Lunge, one hand down, the other arm reaching to the sky. Switch sides halfway.

steps.name: Forward fold
steps.cue: Legs long, knees soft. Fold from the hips, no forcing.

steps.name: Standing twist — left
steps.cue: Feet planted, rotate gently to the left. Let your arms swing with you.

steps.name: Standing twist — right
steps.cue: Rotate to the right.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Come back down, knees wide, and settle in longer this time.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Lie still. Let the floor hold you. Be still, and know that He is God.

routines.title: Wake-up Stretch
routines.summary: Three easy minutes to wake your body up. Standing, no mat needed.

steps.name: Arm circles
steps.cue: Stand tall, small circles growing bigger. Switch direction halfway.

steps.name: Neck half-circles
steps.cue: Chin to chest, then roll slowly from ear to ear.

steps.name: World's greatest stretch
steps.cue: Step one foot back into a lunge, hand down, reach your other arm to the sky.

steps.name: Standing twist
steps.cue: Feet planted, rotate gently side to side and let your arms swing.

steps.name: Hip circles
steps.cue: Hands on hips, slow circles both ways.

steps.name: Calf raises & breath
steps.cue: Rise onto your toes, lower slowly. Breathe in: This is the day the Lord has made. Breathe out: I will rejoice.

routines.title: Easy Outdoor Walk
routines.summary: An easy walk, ideally in daylight. Steps count toward your goal.

routines.title: Restorative Stretch
routines.summary: Long, supported holds that tell your nervous system it's safe to rest.

steps.name: Forward fold
steps.cue: Soft knees, hang your head heavy and let gravity do the work — a long, slow release for your back and hamstrings.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Pillow under your chest if you like. Breathe slowly.

steps.name: Low lunge — left
steps.cue: Left foot forward, back knee down. Sink your hips gently and let your hips open.

steps.name: Low lunge — right
steps.cue: Switch sides.

steps.name: Standing twist — left
steps.cue: Feet planted, rotate gently to the left.

steps.name: Standing twist — right
steps.cue: Rotate to the right.

steps.name: Belly breathing
steps.cue: One hand on your belly. Breathe so it rises and falls slowly.

routines.title: Cramp Relief Flow
routines.summary: Gentle movement and warmth for period days. A heating pad pairs well.
routines.equipment: A pillow, and a heating pad if you have one
routines.caution: Pain bad enough to stop your day isn't something to push through — talk to your doctor.

steps.name: Forward fold
steps.cue: Fold forward over a pillow in your lap. Let your belly soften and breathe.

steps.name: Bird dog
steps.cue: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg long. Move slowly, following your breath.

steps.name: Wide-knee child's pose
steps.cue: Knees wide, belly soft, forehead down.

steps.name: Low lunge — left
steps.cue: Sink your hips gently and let the front of your hip open. Heat on your belly if you have it.

steps.name: Low lunge — right
steps.cue: Switch sides.

steps.name: Standing twist — left
steps.cue: Feet planted, rotate gently to the left.

steps.name: Standing twist — right
steps.cue: Rotate to the right.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Come back down for this last, long rest before we breathe.

steps.name: Warm belly breathing
steps.cue: Hands on your belly. Breathe slowly into the warmth.

routines.summary: Short drills that train the balance you use every day. Keep a counter within reach.

steps.cue: Light fingertips on the counter. Sink into a low lunge on your left leg and hold steady.

steps.name: Low lunge — right
steps.cue: Switch legs.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe. Shake it out. Next one's coming.

steps.name: Hip circles
steps.cue: Hold the counter. Big slow circles both directions — keep your standing leg steady.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe. Shake it out. Next one's coming.

steps.name: Side-lying leg lifts — left
steps.cue: Lie on your side, lift the top leg slowly. This builds the hip strength that keeps you steady on one leg.

steps.cue: Switch sides.

steps.name: Rest
steps.cue: Breathe. Shake it out. Next one's coming.

steps.cue: On hands and knees, reach your right arm and left leg long. Hold steady.

HIGH.verse: Haven't I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don't be afraid. Don't be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
HIGH.reflection: Courage isn't the absence of fear — it's moving forward because God goes with you. Today you have energy to spare; spend it on something that takes courage.
HIGH.prayer: Lord, You go with me today. Make me bold for what matters. Amen.

HIGH.verse: But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
HIGH.reflection: Your strength today is a gift, not an achievement. Run with it — and remember where it comes from.
HIGH.prayer: Father, thank You for strength today. Let me run and not grow weary. Amen.

HIGH.verse: …let's run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
HIGH.reflection: Your race is yours — not anyone else's pace or distance. Lay down what weighs you down and run today with purpose.
HIGH.prayer: Jesus, help me lay aside what holds me back and run my race well. Amen.

HIGH.verse: For God didn't give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
HIGH.reflection: High-energy days are perfect for the thing you've been avoiding. Fear isn't from God; power, love and self-control are.
HIGH.prayer: Holy Spirit, fill me with Your power and love today. Amen.

HIGH.verse: Don't you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.
HIGH.reflection: Paul used the athlete's discipline as a picture of faith. Train your body with purpose today — and train your soul the same way.
HIGH.prayer: Lord, let my discipline today honor You, body and soul. Amen.

HIGH.verse: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
HIGH.reflection: Paul wrote this about contentment in every circumstance — strong days and hard ones alike. Today is a strong one; give Him the credit.
HIGH.prayer: Christ, You are my strength on the good days too. Amen.

STEADY.verse: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,
STEADY.reflection: Steady days are where faithfulness is built — the ordinary reps of life done for an audience of One.
STEADY.prayer: Lord, I offer You the ordinary work of today. Amen.

STEADY.verse: Let's not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don't give up.
STEADY.reflection: Consistency rarely feels dramatic. Keep showing up — the harvest comes in due season.
STEADY.prayer: Father, give me patience to keep sowing. Amen.

STEADY.verse: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
STEADY.reflection: Not a perfect day — this day. Find one ordinary thing to rejoice in before lunch.
STEADY.prayer: Lord, open my eyes to the gifts in this ordinary day. Amen.

STEADY.verse: It is because of the LORD's loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn't fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
STEADY.reflection: Yesterday doesn't define today. His mercy arrived fresh this morning — start from there.
STEADY.prayer: Thank You for new mercy this morning. Great is Your faithfulness. Amen.

STEADY.verse: …present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
STEADY.reflection: Caring for your body is worship when you offer it to God. Today's movement can be a prayer.
STEADY.prayer: Lord, I offer You this body and this day. Amen.

STEADY.verse: Or don't you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit which is in you, which you have from God?
STEADY.reflection: Not a project to perfect — a temple to care for. Eat, move and rest today like it belongs to Someone who loves you.
STEADY.prayer: Holy Spirit, help me care for this temple well today. Amen.

LOW.verse: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
LOW.reflection: Jesus doesn't say "try harder." He says come. On a low-energy day, coming to Him is the whole assignment.
LOW.prayer: Jesus, I'm tired. I come to You. Give me Your rest. Amen.

LOW.verse: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul.
LOW.reflection: Sometimes the Shepherd makes us lie down. A slower day isn't a failure — it may be His leading.
LOW.prayer: Good Shepherd, lead me to still waters today. Restore my soul. Amen.

LOW.verse: Be still, and know that I am God.
LOW.reflection: Stillness is an act of trust. Give God three quiet minutes today before you reach for your phone.
LOW.prayer: Lord, I'm choosing stillness. You are God, and I am not. Amen.

LOW.verse: You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.
LOW.reflection: Strength isn't always loud. Today it may look like quietness and confidence in God.
LOW.prayer: Father, be my quiet strength today. Amen.

LOW.verse: My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.
LOW.reflection: You don't need to feel strong for God to be strong in you. Low days are exactly where His power shows up.
LOW.prayer: Lord, Your grace is enough for today. Be strong in my weakness. Amen.

RECOVER.verse: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, the LORD alone, make me live in safety.
RECOVER.reflection: Rest is trust in action — you lie down because Someone else keeps watch.
RECOVER.prayer: Lord, You keep me safe. I lay this day down in peace. Amen.

RECOVER.verse: …for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
RECOVER.reflection: You don't have to earn rest. It's a gift He gives to the people He loves — and that includes you.
RECOVER.prayer: Father, I receive Your rest as a gift. Amen.

RECOVER.verse: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.
RECOVER.reflection: Some battles are His, not yours. Today, let Him fight while you recover.
RECOVER.prayer: Lord, I hand You what I can't carry today. Amen.

RECOVER.verse: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
RECOVER.reflection: Not in productivity, not in a perfect streak — in God alone.
RECOVER.prayer: My soul rests in You, Lord. Amen.

RECOVER.verse: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don't let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
RECOVER.reflection: The world's peace depends on circumstances. His doesn't. Receive it on a day you can't produce it yourself.
RECOVER.prayer: Jesus, I receive Your peace today. Amen.

RECOVER.verse: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
RECOVER.reflection: If today is heavy, He is not far off. He comes close.
RECOVER.prayer: Lord, come close today. I need You. Amen.
